title: Why the New Grain Is Molded Sweet and Why Hyle's Shadow Makes It Bitter
description: Buds and trees molded and adorned through the cooperative work of the five elements — heat warming and cold nourishing — bringing perception to ripeness as love (warmth) and form-holding truth (cold) work together. But Hyle's energeia, dwelling in those same elements, inundates them with shadow: lack and famine, stumbling and madness in men, the destruction of the fruits of all the trees. The elemental world is the contested ground where divine nourishing and demonic inundation meet.
